assumptions.assumption: R15, R26, R35, R50 are not implemented as they are not directly related to the core functionality of the system and are more related to the development process or HR management.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Missing class for R15: As a user, I want to be able to create an account, so that I can create my own profile.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class for UserAccount or similar.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Missing class for R26: As an employee from the HR department, I want to have access to the full information of all employees working for this business.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class for EmployeeInfo or similar.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Missing class for R35: As a developer, I want to attend some UI/UX lessons, so that I can develop an awesome and beautiful features website.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class for UIUXLessons or similar.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Missing class for R50: As a recyclingfacility representative, I want to have access to user stats and schedules, so that I can adjust my hours and/or upgrade equipment and capacity in order to be able to accomodate larger amounts of recyclable materials.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class for UserStats or similar.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Missing relationship for R14: As a user, I want to get feedback when I enter an invalid zip code.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a relationship between User and Feedback.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Missing relationship for R18: As a user, I want to be able to check transaction history and keep a record of it, so that I can go back when needed.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a relationship between User and TransactionHistory.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Missing relationship for R19: As a user, I want to have a great UI and UX from the sites, so that I have a pleasant experience when navigating through them.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a relationship between User and UIUX.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Missing relationship for R27: As a developer, I want to access an API from the website, so that I can integrate it and implement certain features in my own iOS application.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a relationship between Developer and API.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Missing relationship for R38: As a user, I want to link my email account to my profile, so that I can get a temporary password in case I forget my own one.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a relationship between User and EmailAccount.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Missing relationship for R48: As a user, I want to be able to browse through the list of facilities and see which ones are environment-friendly, so that I can know for sure my waste is not going to leave a negative ecological footprint.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a relationship between User and Facility.
